tei:div.tei:p: /g.yang sgo 'byed pa'i cho ga rin chen lde mig bzhugs so/ /(476)kyai/ de ring bkra shis gdugs gang la// 'jig rten bde legs bya ba dang*// snod bcud dpal 'byor 'phel ba dang*// sbyin bdag tshe bsod rgyas pa'i phyir// bkra shis lha gzhi dkar po bting*// phywa cha g.yang cha ri ltar spangs// gsang sngags ting 'dzin rtsal bskyed de// phywa g.yang 'gugs pa'i las bgyid na// sgo srung rnams kyis g.yang sgo phyes// mgon byed rang rang rten las bzhengs// gsang sngags 'dzin rnams dam rgya khrol// bkra shis g.yang la sgo bzhi yod// sgo bzhi srung ba'i lha bzhi bzhugs// shing me lcags chu'i klong dkyil nas// 'byung ba'i go srung chen po bzhi// stag skya g.yu 'brug sngon mo dang*/ bya dmar rus sbal (477)rgya bo bzhengs// gnas 'dir phyogs bzhi'i g.yang sgo phyes// 'byung ba bzhi yi bcud g.yang khug /lcang lo can dang spos ngad ldan// chos kyi 'phags dang rgya mtsho'i gling*// rin chen pho brang rnam bzhi nas// phyi sgo srung ba'i rgyal chen bzhi// rnam mang thos sras yul 'khor srung*// 'phags skyes po dang spyan mi bzang*// nor bdag chos skyong g.yang gi lhas// naphyogs bzhi g.yang sgo gnas 'dir phyes/ gnod sbyin dri za grul bum dang*// klu dbang tshogs kyi phywa g.yang khug /bkra shis g.yang gi pho brang gi /nang sgo srung mdzad gnod sbyin bzhi// dzam bha la dang gang ba bzang*// ma ṇi bha dra ku be ra// phyag g.yas rin chen mtshon cha bsnams// g.yon pas gter gyi bum pa 'dzin// gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// de ring rin chen mdzod nas bzhengs// gnas 'dir phyogs bzhi'i g.yang sgo phyes// phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad phywa g.yang khug(478)/bkra shis bcud 'khyil g.yang gi mdzod// gsang sgo 'od kyi thig la'i klong*// rdzu 'phrul g.yang gi lha mo bzhi// dkar ser dmar sngo rin chen 'od// phyag g.yas rang rtags mda' dar bsnams// g.yon pas g.yang gi bum pa 'dzin// phyag mda' g.yab mo ling se ling*// g.yang bum dwangs bcud kyi li li// stangs stabs phyag rgya khrigs se khrig

/gnas 'dir phyogs bzhi'i g.yang sgo phyes// shar phyogs rgya dang lho phyogs mon// nub phyogs bal po byang phyogs hor// rigs bzhi'i phywa g.yang byin rlabs khug /khyad par g.yang gi sgo srung ni// sgo lha stag g.yag la sogs pa// g.yang gi ra ba sgo bzhi po// rang rang brtan pa'i gnas nas bzhengs// rin chen lde'u mig phyag tu thogs// g.yang gi mchong sgo smug po phyes// ser po gser kyi 'da' bu khrol// phyi sgo gser gyis mi bso phyes// nang sgo lcags kyi mi bos (479)phyes/ bar 'di nas tshan pa 'ga' zhig chad dam snyam/ karma chags med zhabs= gnas lugs yum mkha' 'od bzhi e dbyings su// brtan bsdus rtogs pa'i sems dpa' waṃ yig gzugs// gnyis sbyor rdo rjes 'khrul pa'i rtog bcom pa// kun bzang shes rab zhabs= dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul padma 'byung*// thugs rje'i zlos gar sku gsum lhun grub dang*// gang gsung nges don zab chos rgya mtsho'i mdzod// lhun grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs= padma ka ra'i zab gsang chu gter las// lung rtogs yon tan yid bzhin nor bu yis// rang gzhan don 'byor sgrub pa'i ded dpon mchog /padma nor bu'i zhabs= pha mtha' bral ba'i mkhyen rab nam mkha'i khyon// gzungs dang ting 'dzin sprin phung g.yo ba las// lung rigs dbyar rnga'i sgrog pa'i rje// chos dpal bzang po'i zhabs= mtha' yas rgyal ba sras bcas mkhyen rtse'i dpal// gcig bsdus phrin las 'od zer stong 'bar nas// bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i (480)padmo rgyas pa'i gnyen// karma lha dbang zhabs= mkha' 'gro'i thugs mdzod gsang chen a ti'i lam// rig stong gnyis med bde chen lhan cig skyes// rtogs goms thabs kyis tshe gcig 'od skur smin// karma don dam zhabs= ka dag dbyings las lhun grub rig pa'i gdangs// zung 'jug rgyal kun thugs che'i rol pa las// 'gyur med bde chen rdo rje'i skur smin pa// nges don bstan 'dzin bzang por=

'jam dpal byin rlabs bi ma'i rnam par 'phrul// rgyal sras lha rje'i yang srid bcu gsum pa// bka' bab bdun ldan padma mdo sngags gling*// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse'i dbang por= shes bya kun gzigs yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter// rgyal bas lung bstan blo gros mtha' g.yas sde// rigs kun khyab bdag padma gar gyi dbang*// 'jam gling shing rta chen por = 'jigs med gsang ngen gangs kyi ri la 'gyings// theg mchog chos kyi nga ros sa gsum khyab// 'khor 'das rang grol chen po mngon sum (481)gzigs// 'jigs med rang grol= phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal gyi 'byung gnas yul// padma'i ring lugs rgya mtsho'i mdzod khang cher// mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' thang 'dzin mdzad pa// mdo sngags bstan 'dzin= o rgyan rgyal ba'i ring lugs mdo dang sngags// gsang chen man ngag chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur// bstan pa'i nyi ma mtshungs med rigs kyi bdag /klong chen nam mkha'i rdo rjer= dgongs brgyud byin rlabs rtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ nges don lam gyi 'od dkar phyogs brgyar 'bar// rmad byung thabs kyis 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa// rtsa brgyud bla rnams la= de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// dad dang nges 'byung snying rjes rgyud drangs nas// byang chub sems mchog rim gnyis mthar phyin te// tshe (482)gcig sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog /ces pa 'di ni sngon gyi dam pa dag gi gsung sor bzhag karma bkra shis man gyis tshig rnams gsar du brtsam// rje bla ma padma mdo sngags kyi gsol 'debs karma tshe dpal gsung sor bzhag ste lhan gcig bsgrigs pa 'di ni grub pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba dpal yul ba'i gral mthar skyes shing snyom las pa padma shes rab bzang pos bris pa dge'o/// dge'o// dge'o//
